The signature

One bag.
An entire gallery.

Every bag I make has a clear pocket on the front, sized to an ordinary 10×15 print. Four cards come with your bag — chosen from my catalogue, or printed from your own photographs.

Change it with the season. Change it with your coat. Change it because it is Tuesday and you would rather look at the sea.

Cut, stitched and assembled by one pair of hands. Most colours exist in one or two pieces — when they are gone, they are gone.

The detail everyone asks about

The pocket that steps outside.

Inside the full-size Gallery hangs a small pocket, slung from the wooden handles and held against the wall of the bag by magnets. Lift it over the handles and it lives on the outside instead — the main compartment empties, and the pocket still opens and closes exactly as before.

Card slots inside, for the things that must stay within reach. It is my own design, and it is on no other bag in the world.

The suspended pocket · Gallery only

The maker

My strength is the part
you do not see.

My name is Dasha, and I am the founder of L'artDari. I make bags inspired by art — and I build a space into every one of them for a picture that can change, so the bag can move with its owner's mood, her season, her outfit.

My strength as a designer is in unusual engineering decisions and in new shapes — the small mechanisms that make a bag work better than it looks. I am glad the work finds a response in people's hearts. And I do not intend to stop: ahead there are new ideas, new inspiration, new bags.

Every bag on this page was cut, stitched and finished by hand — mine.

Every accessory is a work of art.

L'artDari · Moscow
Birch plywood · jointed corners · green ribbon
Worldwide

Shipped in a wooden crate,
because cardboard lies.

No carton survives days of aircraft, ship and truck — and none of us can influence how carefully a courier handles a parcel. So we stopped using cardboard and built our own: a jointed birch plywood box, engraved with the monogram and tied with green ribbon.

Inside, the bag is wrapped in cloth and fixed with the house pin, so nothing can touch the leather. With this packaging, nothing frightens us.

Free courier delivery inside Moscow. CDEK across Russia. For every other country the route is chosen per destination — the fastest way that arrives safely.

Ordering

Every order is a conversation
with the person who makes it.

We agree the bag

Leather, lining and handle wood for a made-to-order piece — or I find you the right one from what is ready now.

You choose four paintings

From my catalogue, or send your own images. They arrive with the bag, as a gift.

Delivery details

Address, full name, telephone. For international orders, postcode and email as well.

Payment

By card details or an invoice I issue. Made-to-order pieces may be paid in two parts — half at order, the balance on completion.

Built, crated, sent

A bag from stock can leave within a day. A made-to-order piece is cut and stitched for you alone.

Before you write to anyone

  • I have no managers. I take every order myself, through @lartdari_order on Telegram or lartdari on Instagram — nowhere else.
  • I never write to you first. You always begin the conversation.
  • I would never ask you to delete your questions or your comments.
  • Anyone who does otherwise is not L'artDari. Please be careful.
